mintAuthority.summary: QCAD token ownership and immediate proxy upgrades on Ethereum and Base use distinct chain-local 3/6 Safe instances. The token-owner Safes and proxy-admin Safes have different signer compositions; no modules or guards were detected. Stablecorp's issuance backend mints through the Safe-controlled token contracts.

controls.label: Stablecorp issuance backend (servicer to QCAD Digital Trust)
controls.evidence: Stablecorp (FINTRAC MSB) administers the QCAD Program as servicer; authorized dealers/qualified holders mint QCAD 1:1 on CAD deposit and redeem at par against trust-held reserves, so Stablecorp controls supply creation.

controls.label: Stablecorp token owner — Gnosis Safe (6 signers, threshold 3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295037, owner() on QCAD ETH proxy 0x3fa142dd returned 0x4ff9ace93dd7a18bd7014aa9a179117adf20f6a9. getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 3; VERSION() = '1.4.1'; getModulesPaginated returned empty array; guard storage slot = 0x0; fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732dc. Same Safe is owner on Base (confirmed via owner() at Base block 47200812).

controls.label: Proxy-admin upgrade authority — Ethereum and Base
controls.evidence: On Ethereum and Base, the EIP-1967 proxy-admin slots resolve to ProxyAdmins 0xcf09e8de3086678557dca73d7e4de7763cfdbbdd and 0x3037bd16377c89fcdffe785bec945b8e383db599. Each ProxyAdmin is owned by its chain-local Safe instance at 0x6c4c5c74a29b1985f08149fb422f5afa03b4f59e. Current on-chain reads returned Safe v1.4.1, threshold 3, six owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard; the signer set differs from the token-owner Safe at its second signer.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Base reads resolve chain-local QCAD token-owner Safes at 0x4ff9ace93dd7a18bd7014aa9a179117adf20f6a9 and separate chain-local proxy-admin Safes at 0x6c4c5c74a29b1985f08149fb422f5afa03b4f59e. Each Safe is 3/6 with no enabled modules or guard. The proxy-admin Safe signer set was refreshed on 2026-07-13 and differs from the token-owner Safe. Both transparent-proxy implementations and immediate ProxyAdmin paths are identified. QCAD is issued by QCAD Digital Trust under a receipted OSC prospectus in the CSA value-referenced crypto asset (VRCA) interim framework (final CSA approval 2025-11-24); the prospectus requires reserves at least equal to circulating QCAD held in segregated accounts at Canadian financial institutions and names Kingston Ross Pasnak LLP as auditor providing monthly attestations plus audited annual financials on SEDAR+. Reconciled monthly and prudentially supervised by a named securities regulator places QCAD in the moderate tier; the separate Stablecorp FINTRAC MSB registration is AML-only and not counted as prudential. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: unbounded issuer/backend mint and immediate Safe-controlled upgrades; monthly full-liability assurance and OSC/CSA product supervision remain supported.
